iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

HTTP2::requests
       This command can be used to determine the count of requests received in the current HTTP/2 session.

SYNOPSIS
       HTTP2::requests

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the count of requests received in the current HTTP/2 session. This includes the current request. Returns 0 if
       HTTP/2 is not active.

RETURN VALUE
       The return is a number indicating count of requests received in current HTTP/2 session. The return is 0 if HTTP/2 is not
       active.

VALID DURING
       HTTP_REQUEST HTTP_PROXY_REQUEST

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	    log local0. "Number of requests received in current session is [HTTP2::requests]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
